desc: Implement O(NK^2) prefix-sum pair moment solution: P_0=0, answer += sum_{t=0}^{K} C(K,t)(-1)^t P_j^{K-t} S_t for each j, then update S_t += P_j^t; print mod 998244353.
Verify the implemented code against all three samples (75, 0, 428633385) and edge cases N=1 with K=10 and A_i=0.
Derive the binomial expansion for (P_r - P_s)^K reorganized by fixing the right endpoint j.
Determine prefix-sum moments S_t = sum_{i<j} P_i^t for t=0..K and incremental updates.
Design O(N K^2) accumulation using binomial coefficients and modular arithmetic.
